0.DSCR:
Second son of the $$神家$$ and main pilot of $$ザンボット３$$. Age 12. A first-year middle school student.
He was a delinquent well known in his hometown, spending his days brawling and riding a motorbike around without a license. At heart, though, he was kind, a warm-hearted person who could not leave anyone in trouble alone.
With the piloting methods he had learned through sleep learning, together with his natural athleticism and sharp instincts, he handled $$ザンバード$$, $$ザンボエース$$ and $$ザンボット３$$ as if they were his own limbs. Yet however desperately he fought $$ガイゾック$$, he grew more and more frustrated that the people around him did not understand. But after witnessing the escalating acts of destruction and ruthless schemes such as the human bombs, and after making peace with those he had been at odds with, he grew as a human being.
In the final battle, though reduced to $$ザンボエース$$ alone, he destroyed $$ガイゾック$$, then returned alone to the home where he was born, unconscious. Amid a crowd crying out in joy, he woke up on $$ミチ$$'s lap.

1.DSCR:
Eldest son of the $$神江家$$ and pilot of $$ザンブル$$. Age 15. A third-year middle school student.
He had a cynical air and appearance, but like $$勝平$$ he had a warm heart at bottom. Rational and quick-witted, he sometimes contributed to victory by devising strategies. He had a younger brother named $$和行$$ and a younger sister named $$きいろ$$, and both looked up to him as a good older brother.
Unlike the other members of the $$神ファミリー$$, he had what could be called an 'education mama' for a mother, and he felt guilty about a mother who, heedless of the situation around her, tried to protect only her own life and household possessions. He once clashed with $$勝平$$, who mocked her for it, but they deepened their bond through fighting.
In the final battle, under the fierce assault of $$バンドック$$, he realized that neither he nor his machine could last long, and together with $$恵子$$ he made a suicidal charge at the exhaust port to open a breakthrough. Even facing certain death, he apologized to $$恵子$$, saying that if he could have acted alone he would not have had to drag her into it, showing a kindness that cared more for others than for himself. Then, amid the soaring debris, he vanished into space shouting $$勝平$$'s name as if entrusting his feelings to him.

2.DSCR:
Eldest daughter of the $$神北家$$ and pilot of $$ザンベース$$. Age 13 (through Episode 11). A second-year middle school student.
Her family ran a ranch in Shinshu, and she was a lively, easygoing girl whose specialties were horseback riding and archery.
When she returned to her hometown on her birthday, she showed a moment of weakness: like the other members of the $$神ファミリー$$, she was unfairly resented by her friends and was shocked. But she recovered through her mother's feelings, and seeing her keep up rescue work despite an injury from a stray bullet, her friends cleared up their misunderstanding and came to meet her halfway.
In the decisive battle with $$バンドック$$, seeing that fighting in $$ザンボット３$$ was impossible, she detached the still-operational $$ザンボエース$$ and, together with $$宇宙太$$, made a suicidal charge at the exhaust port to open a breakthrough. Even at the brink of death, she showed the fortitude to gently rebuke $$宇宙太$$, who was apologizing for having dragged her into the charge. But in her final moment there was the figure of a girl her age, calling out the names of her father and mother.

3.DSCR:
$$勝平$$'s beloved dog. It was given the name Nishiki (brocade) from the flower-petal pattern on its forehead.
When the team sortied, it boarded the right cockpit of $$ザンバード$$ together with $$勝平$$. Eventually it came to take over $$勝平$$'s call of 'Wan!' (which means 'One!' in Japanese and is also a dog's bark) during combination.
When $$ザンボエース$$ charged into the interior of $$バンドック$$, it lost its life to a direct hit from the laser of the automatic defense system.

4.DSCR:
$$兵左衛門$$ held a position that could be called the elder of the $$神ファミリー$$, and with strong will and conviction united the clan to take on the fight against $$ガイゾック$$.
He and $$梅江$$, a good adviser, were cousins, not husband and wife.
In the end, together with $$梅江$$, he made a suicidal charge at $$バンドック$$ in $$ビアルⅡ世$$ to save $$キング・ビアル$$ from crisis. Entrusting the future to the younger generation, he brought the curtain down on life.

proofread.reason: pronouns: Heizaemon is researched male; the old rule repeated his name in every sentence, replaced with 'he' (first sentence keeps the name; the Japanese states none there)

5.DSCR:
$$勝平$$'s father. Age 48.
As the head of a fishing crew, he ran $$神水産$$ in Suruga Bay. After $$ビアルⅠ世$$ was discovered, he served as its captain and commanded in battle.
Strict by nature, he nonetheless loved his wife and children deeply, a man of the sea full of generosity and manly spirit. Because he had often been away from home on deep-sea fishing trips, he knew how precious time spent with family was.
His end, too, was a harrowing one: he made a suicidal charge at $$赤騎士デスカイン$$ and $$青騎士ヘルダイン$$ to protect his beloved wife to the last.

proofread.reason: mistranslation/omission: 特攻 (suicide charge) was rendered as a plain 'charged'; other entries render 特攻 as 'suicidal charge'

6.DSCR:
$$勝平$$'s older brother. Age 17.
Serious and mild-mannered, in contrast to his younger brother. He took charge of combat command aboard $$ビアルⅠ世$$ and $$キング・ビアル$$.
He had keen insight and discovered the combination system of $$ザンボット３$$. On that occasion, to rebuke $$勝平$$ and the others, who were out of step, he halted the movement of $$ザンボエース$$ and threatened them, saying 'We have no use for a $$勝平$$ with no sense of solidarity or a $$神ファミリー$$ that cannot fight, so let's all die together,' forcing them to agree to combine. He sometimes took bold and resourceful actions like this.
After the showdown with $$ガイゾック$$ he had barely survived, but he used $$ビアルⅠ世$$ to slow $$バンドック$$ as it plunged into the atmosphere, saved $$勝平$$, who had been left behind inside, and was swallowed by the flames of the explosion, leaving this world.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 'with Beal I' attached to the plunging Bandock; the Japanese says he slowed Bandock by means of Beal I (ビアルⅠ世で減速させ)

7.DSCR:
$$勝平$$'s grandmother. Age 68.
In her role as adviser to the $$神ファミリー$$, she had the complete trust of even $$兵左衛門$$.
Her favorite music was rock, and she once put on a combat suit and sortied on her own to save $$野崎$$, the object of her first love. She was a spry granny who never seemed her age.
When they went up into space for the decisive battle, she and $$兵左衛門$$ made a suicidal charge at $$バンドック$$ in $$ビアルⅡ世$$ to save $$キング・ビアル$$, which had fallen into peril. Entrusting the future to her grandchildren, she brought the curtain down on her life.
Before that sortie, she left behind a keepsake bowl that she said $$兵左衛門$$ had given her in their youth.

8.DSCR:
$$勝平$$'s mother. Age 35.
Just as she looked, she was bold and generous by nature.
Besides her love for her two sons and her husband, she showed strength and motherliness when $$香月$$ fired a gun out of misplaced resentment: unafraid of the gun, she slapped $$香月$$ and set the mistake right.
Just before the final battle with $$ガイゾック$$, she was sent back to Earth by the older men, who did not want to involve women and children in the fighting. Then, when $$勝平$$, who had survived the battle, returned, she rushed to his side.

9.DSCR:
The boy who led the $$香月$$ Gang, a group of delinquents at odds with $$勝平$$.
$$ガイゾック$$'s attack separated him from his parents and his sister $$かおる$$. Convinced that the cause lay with the $$神ファミリー$$, he harbored a strong hatred.
However, after witnessing the ruthless schemes of $$ガイゾック$$ such as the human bombs, he gradually changed his mind. Eventually he was himself caught in a predicament in which he was nearly turned into a human bomb, but he escaped the crisis, helped by $$勝平$$'s efforts. After reconciling with $$勝平$$, whom he met again, he cooperated with him from then on, and went up into space, the site of the decisive battle, together with the $$神ファミリー$$.
Just before the final battle with $$ガイゾック$$, he was sent back to Earth by the older men, who did not want to involve women and children in the fighting, and right after waking he lamented that he had wanted to fight alongside them.
Together with $$ミチ$$, he was the first to find $$勝平$$ when $$勝平$$ returned after the fighting, and watched over the sleeping face, still trembling in fear of the battle.

10.DSCR:
One of $$勝平$$'s personal guard, known as '$$ブスペア$$.' Age 12.
She and her family suffered from $$ガイゾック$$'s attack, and her mother was badly injured. Blaming the $$神ファミリー$$ for the cause, she vented fierce anger at $$勝平$$. Deep down, though, she understood that it was not $$勝平$$ and the others who were truly to blame, and with her mother's words as well, she gradually made peace with him.
Eventually she was captured by $$ガイゾック$$, but rescued by $$勝平$$. By then, however, $$アキ$$'s body had already been converted into a human bomb. Just before $$勝平$$, who had been alerted by $$兵左衛門$$ to the possibility of a human bomb, rushed to her room, $$アキ$$'s body was engulfed in light. All that remained of her was a scrap of pajamas left in $$勝平$$'s hand.

11.DSCR:
One of $$勝平$$'s personal guard, known as '$$ブスペア$$.'
She and her family suffered from $$ガイゾック$$'s attack, and, convinced that the cause lay with the $$神ファミリー$$, she vented resentment at $$勝平$$.
Captured by $$ガイゾック$$ like $$アキ$$, she was rescued by $$香月$$ before being turned into a human bomb, and barely managed to escape.
After the fighting was over, she gently held $$勝平$$, who had returned to Earth unconscious. When $$香月$$ pointed out the feelings she had been holding back, she blushed.

proofread.reason: pronouns: Michi is researched female (ブスペア girls); the old rule repeated the name in every sentence, replaced with she/her; the Japanese has no name in these sentences

12.DSCR:
The electronic brain that is the main body of $$ガイゾック$$, located at the core of $$バンドック$$.
After devastating the planet $$ビアル星$$ 200 years earlier, it had ceased activity, but when it approached the Earth's vicinity it started its program again and gave $$ブッチャー$$ instructions to exterminate the people of Earth.
Its true identity was an artificial intelligence built long ago by the $$ガイゾック$$ aliens for the purpose of driving out every living being with malice in the entire universe.
Even when it faced $$ザンボエース$$ after losing the battle, it kept declaring to $$勝平$$ to the very end that humankind on Earth was evil, even as it collapsed.

13.DSCR:
Pilot of $$ダイターン３$$. Known everywhere by name, and nicknamed 'the $$破嵐万丈$$ of rumor.' Age 18.
A dependable man, cheerful and bright, brimming with humor, who never lost his composure even in a pinch. The reason his dandyish, self-assured manner does not come across as irritating is the very human side he shows now and then.
His physical ability was also outstanding, enough to fight the $$メガノイド$$s on even terms in person.
He fiercely hated the $$メガノイド$$s, and the father who created the $$メガノイド$$s and made his brother and mother into test subjects. He had a ruthless side that would sacrifice even his comrades if it meant destroying the $$メガノイド$$s, but his comrades trusted and cared for him immensely, that side included.
During the decisive battle with the $$メガノイド$$ leader $$ドン・ザウサー$$, $$万丈$$ heard an apology from his father, $$創造$$, but rejected it, and alone put an end to his feud with the $$メガノイド$$s.

14.DSCR:
The butler who serves $$万丈$$. Age 55.
Starting with looking after $$万丈$$'s personal needs, he perfectly handled every job, from preparing meals to maintaining the various mecha to even sortieing in $$ダイターン３$$: a butler among butlers.
His background and past career were completely unknown, but thanks to his high ability and his character, $$万丈$$ and the others placed complete trust in him.
He was also a first-rate shot; by his own account, in his younger days people used to say, 'Is it Wyatt Earp, or $$ギャリソン$$?'

15.DSCR:
$$万丈$$'s assistant. Age 17.
She was originally a student at the Interpol Academy, but met $$万丈$$ while investigating a certain $$メガノイド$$ incident, and afterward began acting together with him.
Befitting a former member of Interpol, she is well versed in handling firearms and piloting mecha, a cool, dependable, intellectual beauty. But when it comes to $$万丈$$, she clashes with $$ビューティ$$, and it is not rare for her to show herself sinking to $$ビューティ$$'s level.

16.DSCR:
$$万丈$$'s little-brother figure, a mischievous boy who calls himself the First Assistant. Age 10.
He lost his parents to the $$メガノイド$$s, and after meeting $$万丈$$ and fighting alongside him, he ended up staying on at $$万丈$$'s mansion.
He is known for his 'hot-blooded fireball' personality and for apparently having 'a big dream.'

17.DSCR:
$$万丈$$'s assistant. Age 17.
She had lived without a care as the daughter of the president of $$ビューティー観光$$, but she volunteered to be an assistant to find out whether the renowned $$万丈$$ was really the man rumor made him out to be.
She has the beauty to have won the beauty contest '$$ミス・インタービューティ$$,' and her style is outstanding too. But she has an extremely childish personality, and she fights with $$レイカ$$ over $$万丈$$, and with $$トッポ$$, whose mental age is close to her own, with no pretense at all.

29.DSCR:
The scientist who designed Trider.
Their true identity was $$ナバロン$$, the former director of the Mecha Development Laboratory of the $$ロボット帝国$$. Strongly wishing to build a real robot, $$ナバロン$$ escaped the Empire.
Afterward, $$道太郎$$, $$ワッ太$$'s father, saved $$ナバロン$$'s life, gave them the name $$梅本$$, and supported them in various ways. To repay that debt, $$梅本$$ designed Trider.
$$梅本$$ had been in contact with $$柿小路$$ and $$厚井$$, but had never met $$ワッ太$$.

proofread.reason: pronouns: Umemoto and Navaron are researched gender unknown, so he/his/him are defects; rewritten with 'their'/'them'/name repetition. Content unchanged.

30.DSCR:
The boy who pilots $$鉄人２８号#pilot$$. Age 11.
He was entrusted with $$鉄人２８号#pilot$$, the giant robot developed by his father, Dr. $$金田$$, and completed by his father's friend Dr. $$敷島$$.
Already without parents, he now lived in the annex of the $$敷島$$ estate.
Thoroughly serious in nature and possessed of a strong sense of justice, he never let wrongdoing slide, and had the courage to confront villains even unarmed and in the flesh.
He also had a mischievous streak fitting his age, and often showed his boyish side around $$マッキー$$, who had been raised almost as his sibling. His boundless curiosity was also what led him to discover $$鉄人$$ hidden away at the $$敷島$$ estate in the first place.
When $$グーラ$$ was unearthed from the time capsule, $$正太郎$$ was there the moment he awoke, and was the first to reach out a hand, hoping to become his friend. Though he and $$グーラ$$ would later become enemies, in his heart he kept believing $$グーラ$$ would act for the sake of the Earth.
In the end he was forced to face $$グーラ$$, who had chosen to live for his father over the Earth, and was left to defeat him at the hands of $$鉄人$$, which he himself controlled. Afterward, holding the sword $$グーラ$$ left behind, he mourned his friend's death with the words, 'Next time we meet, leave the sword behind.'

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 自らの操る鉄人の手で = by the hand of the Tetsujin he himself pilots, not 'with his own hands'

31.DSCR:
A robot conceived and designed by Dr. $$金田$$ and completed by Dr. $$敷島$$.
It is operated by rainbow waves transmitted from $$正太郎$$'s Vision Controller, known as the V-Con.
It is equipped with a solar energy amplification system that grants it near-limitless operating time so long as it has sunlight, and an independent linkage system that lets it keep moving even if part of its body is destroyed. It also boasts a top flight speed of Mach 4.02, underwater travel at 40 knots, and a ground speed of up to 300 km/h, and its sensor light with a built-in radar unit lets it operate in darkness as well, making it capable of activity anywhere, including in space.
In keeping with Dr. $$金田$$'s ideal of a messenger of peace, it carries no dedicated weapons, but the hammer punch, flying kick, and other techniques unleashed by its sturdy super-alloy body are each a lethal blow.
For all its high performance, its one weakness is that it is only as good or bad as its remote control. When villains have seized the V-Con, $$鉄人$$ has carried out acts of destruction under their command.
In the final battle, it defeated the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ by fully releasing its solar energy at the cost of itself. $$正太郎$$ was plunged into grief, but before long the V-Con responded again, and $$鉄人$$ returned safely.

32.DSCR:
A robot with a will of its own, developed in the $$Ｘ団$$'s underground factory.
It was originally meant to have the entire brain of its creator, Dr. $$不乱拳$$, copied into it, but the copying process was cut short at only one hundred-thousandth complete, leaving it with the intelligence of a three-year-old.
In power and speed it is a match for $$鉄人$$. It can also fire a powerful electromagnetic beam from its eyes that stops any mechanical device.
After the $$Ｘ団$$ killed Dr. $$不乱拳$$, it was entrusted to Dr. $$敷島$$, but when the $$Ｘ団$$'s $$ガンガル$$ disguised himself as Dr. $$不乱拳$$ and gave it orders, it was made to fight $$鉄人$$.
After $$ガンガル$$ was defeated, it began fighting alongside $$鉄人$$ of its own free will, becoming a reliable ally.
It later received an education from Dr. $$敷島$$, and showed growth in both its combat style and behavior. When $$鉄人$$ was driven into a corner by $$グーラ$$, it rushed dashingly to the rescue and saved it from the crisis.
It went on to throw itself into further battles, but after being fitted with a hypnosis device, it lost its sense of self and once again became $$鉄人$$'s enemy. The device was destroyed in battle and it came back to its senses, but in trying to make up for its own mistake it fought recklessly, and was ultimately destroyed.

proofread.reason: pronoun: the one rescued is Tetsujin (gender not applicable), so 'it', not 'him'

33.DSCR:
Dr. $$敷島$$'s only daughter. Age 11.
$$正太郎$$'s girlfriend, the same age as him and his childhood friend.
Cheerful and caring, though $$正太郎$$ is actually the more mature of the two, she often acts the part of the big sister.
Her hobby is tennis, and she is extremely lively and proactive. This has occasionally backfired, though, leading her to act without regard for danger and end up taken captive.
Being of an age to notice such things, she fell quite hard for $$グーラ$$ while he was living with the $$敷島$$ family.

35.DSCR:
A servant robot developed to support $$鉄人$$.
Its name is read 'Zero-Hachi.'
Its main role is repairing $$鉄人$$, but by swapping cassettes through the slot in its abdomen, it can automatically perform most any task, from standing guard to tending the garden.

36.DSCR:
Son of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$. Known as the Demon Beast Prince.
He had been asleep in a capsule excavated from underground, but was awakened by Dr. $$敷島$$ and his team.
Present at the moment of his awakening, $$正太郎$$ offered his hand and the two became friends. He was also accepted by the $$敷島$$ family, with $$マッキー$$ in particular falling for him.
One day, however, an experiment probing $$グーラ$$'s memories revealed his true identity as the son of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$. $$正太郎$$ and the others tried to keep it from him, but the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s voice echoed in his head, and he remembered his own origins.
Though he felt friendship toward $$正太郎$$, he obeyed his father the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ in the effort to claim the Earth, at times sending his subordinate Demon Generals and at times personally piloting a $$スペースロボ$$, fighting $$正太郎$$ again and again.
When $$正太郎$$ and his friends finally closed in on the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, $$グーラ$$ was talked into a solo sortie by $$ロビー$$'s smooth words. He lost his life after a fierce battle.

37.DSCR:
The demon king who rules the universe.
He was once human, but when his home planet was swallowed by a black hole, his will to live caused him to merge with it, and he survived as this being.
Utterly cold and merciless by nature, he rules the universe through fear and violence. Yet toward his son $$グーラ$$, he sometimes showed the warmer face of a parent.
At first he intended to swallow the Earth in one stroke, but held back after $$グーラ$$ talked him out of it. When $$グーラ$$ then lost his life in the confrontation with $$鉄人$$, though, he burned with rage and unleashed cataclysms upon the Earth.
When $$正太郎$$ and the others plunged into the dark sun at the heart of the black hole, he appeared by converting the power of his convictions into energy, and drove $$鉄人$$ into a corner with overwhelming force.
In the end, he vanished along with the dark sun when $$鉄人$$ released its solar energy.

38.DSCR:
A robotic life form who serves the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$.
A survivor of a planet the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ once destroyed, $$ロビー$$ possesses a brain with an IQ of 631.
Though slight of build at a glance, $$ロビー$$ shows considerable skill in hand-to-hand combat as well. $$ロビー$$ also has the ability to teleport, making for all-around capability in any situation.
After being made $$グーラ$$'s attendant by the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s order, $$ロビー$$ supported $$グーラ$$ in the role of advisor, all while secretly plotting revenge against the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$.
In time $$ロビー$$ skillfully maneuvered $$グーラ$$ into a fatal confrontation with $$鉄人$$, then threw in with $$正太郎$$ and the others. Once satisfied at seeing the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s downfall, $$ロビー$$ vanished by teleportation to parts unknown, unnoticed by anyone.

proofread.reason: pronouns: Robby is researched gender unknown, so he/his/him for Robby are defects; rewritten with the name (the 'him' that means Gura is unchanged). Content unchanged.

45.DSCR:
The emperor who rules the planet $$ギシン星$$.
He schemed to rule the entire universe through fear and violence, and treated every inhabitant of the planets under his control as a pawn for his own ambitions.
Though he commanded many subordinates, he regarded every one of them as no more than a 'tool.' He was cold by nature: he never forgave those who defied his will or betrayed him, and even to a subordinate who tried to take his own life in shame over a failure, he coldly declared, 'Die for me.' He also calmly committed such atrocities as abducting $$マーグ$$ after $$マーグ$$'s reunion with $$タケル$$, taking control of $$マーグ$$'s mind, and then making $$マーグ$$ fight $$タケル$$.
Though defeated at the end of $$タケル$$'s desperate battle after $$タケル$$ stormed into $$ギシン星$$, he vanished leaving these ominous words: 'I shall not die! Every single one of my cells will spread across the universe, and there I will become a ruler once again!'
Eventually he did revive just as he had said, but was defeated once more at the hands of $$タケル$$, who carried the wishes of many people.

46.DSCR:
A new enemy who stands in $$タケル$$'s way. Its name is $$メタール$$.
$$ゲシュタルト$$ is the collective name for six individuals including $$メタール$$; the other five are $$ボーデ$$, $$スナッパー$$, $$ナッカー$$, $$ニード$$ and $$キッカ#gestalt$$.
No expression can be read from their mask-like faces, and they are beings of much mystery, appearing again even after seeming to be swallowed up by the explosion of a combat mecha.
Their true identity was the composite life form that makes up $$皇帝ズール$$, and when all of the $$ゲシュタルト$$ became one, $$ズール$$ appeared once again.

51.DSCR:
An $$ＡＴ$$ pilot who belonged to the $$メルキア$$ Army of the $$ギルガメス$$ faction. His rank was sergeant major.
Perhaps because he grew up constantly exposed to the flames of war from an early age, living day after day alongside death, he is extremely taciturn and unsociable, but his skill piloting an $$ＡＴ$$ is outstanding. He also possesses excellent situational judgment and superb physical abilities. He shows what could be called all-around competence in anything related to combat, from gathering parts from scrap to repair an $$ＡＴ$$ to writing a combat program overnight.
He possesses the quality known as an $$異能生存体$$, showing an uncanny run of luck whenever he faces death and a recovery ability roughly three times that of an ordinary person. Selected for the $$レッドショルダー$$ unit on the strength of these abilities, he was afterward placed under the watch of $$ヨラン・ペールゼン$$. In the end, though, $$ペールゼン$$ grew fearful of his abnormal power and moved to have his life taken.
After many battles, he took part in the assault on the asteroid $$リド$$ near the end of the $$百年戦争$$. His encounter, during the operation, with the 'Perfect Soldier' found inside a capsule drew him into a fate even more turbulent than before.
He was reunited with the Perfect Soldier, $$フィアナ$$, in the city of $$ウド$$, and a heart that had known nothing but fighting slowly began to change.
After $$ウド$$'s collapse, he drifted on to the Kingdom of $$クメン$$ and then the planet $$サンサ$$, and his days there were never free of battle. His fight to reclaim $$フィアナ$$ after the $$秘密結社$$ took her, and to protect her, gradually turned into a search for the secret of his own self.
All of this had been orchestrated by $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, the shadow ruler of $$アストラギウス$$, and $$キリコ$$, by virtue of his qualities as an $$異能生存体$$, had been chosen as his successor and put to the test.
Refusing to be controlled, $$キリコ$$ feigned acceptance of the position of successor, closed in on $$ワイズマン#pilot$$ where he lay hidden deep in the ruins of $$クエント$$, and shut down all of his functions.
Afterward, dreaming of a world without war, he entered a long sleep together with $$フィアナ$$, only to have his cryogenic sleep broken by a reviver known as a Retriever.
For the sole purpose of getting $$フィアナ$$ back, he took on the Pan-Galactic Society $$マーティアル$$ and stormed alone into its holy site, $$アレギウム$$. He won a fierce battle against the $$ネクスタント$$ $$テイタニア$$ and finally reunited with $$フィアナ$$, only for her to breathe her last in his arms.
After that, he set off alone without telling anyone where he was going.

pilot 3: the 'Wan!' call: the source only says the dog took over Kappei's combination call 'Wan!' The pun (Japanese for 'One!' and a dog's bark) is my gloss in parentheses; drop it if the orchestrator prefers a bare 'Wan!'.

Zambot 3 names (Zambird, Zambo Ace, Zambase, Zambull, Beal, King Beal, Buccha, Red Knight Deskain, Blue Knight Heldain, Gaizok, Jin/Kamie/Kamikita family names other than the wiki three) have no wiki source; they are straight romanizations. The 'Beal' spelling for ビアル is my recollection of common fan English, not confirmed. Family names are tokens (神家, 神江家, 神北家, 神ファミリー) so they can be changed once.

pilot 16: 戸田突太 has no reading in the entry; proposed 'Toppo Toda' (nickname used for the given name).

pilot 29: 'Trider' kept literal (the sheet only has トライダーＧ７, and the Jigoku reuse entries also write 'Trider'); 梅本 and ナバロン are the same scientist so 'Umemoto' is used after the reveal. 道太郎 = Watta's father.

pilot 30/31/32/33/35/36/37/38: kept Jigoku English sentence by sentence after checking every sentence against the Tengoku Japanese; the only changes are tokens (Dr. Kaneda -> $$金田$$, X Gang, Furanken, Gangaru, Space Robo, Makki). 'Demon Generals' and 'Demon Beast Prince' stay literal as in Jigoku.

pilot 45/46: ズール is proposed as 'Xul' (matches the glossary's official 皇帝ズール = Emperor Xul). 46 uses the 皇帝ズール token for Emperor Xul and ズール for the second mention. メタール etc. (Metaal, Bode, Snapper, Knocker, Need, Kikka) are my romanizations; 名称はメタール is read as the enemy of this entry being named Metaal (the group is Gestalt).

pilot 51-61: 素体 stays 'Perfect Soldier' as in Jigoku (the Japanese word is 素体, literally base body; Jigoku's choice kept for consistency, but it is a rendering the orchestrator may want to revisit; ＰＳ is the separate token).

Kuent vs Quent: the Jigoku English wrote 'Kuent' but the sheet token クエント is 'Quent' (proposed); I used the token. Likewise クメン = Kummen and アレギウム = Allegium come from the sheet, not from Jigoku's 'Kuent'/'Aregium' spellings.

pilot 51: in the Jigoku sentence 'the Nextant pilot Teitania' I dropped 'pilot' (the source says ネクスタントのテイタニア, a Nextant is a bio-weapon type, not a pilot role). pilot 60: Jigoku's 'boarded the Alegium' changed to 'stormed into' (アレギウム is a holy site; 乗り込んで = barge in).
